audit.whatIsWrong: The packet itself flags the chart: Yone wins 47.97% here but the chart gives Yone 4 of 7 stages and Zaahen none. No stage on the page is assigned to Zaahen at all.
audit.why: A sub-50% matchup with zero enemy-owned stages cannot be right, but nothing in the kits or the packet says WHICH stages are his, and there is no mirror to invert.
audit.corrected: No chart rows changed — the direction of the fix is unknowable from the data available, so it is raised as a question rather than guessed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike named his abilities without a single cooldown, so 'play the cooldown game' had no cooldowns in it.
audit.why: His Q is 10/9/8/7/6s, his E 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and his R 110/95/80s — those three numbers are the whole tempo of the lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text and mid rewritten with the real timers alongside the corrected names.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two of Zaahen's abilities are called by names that do not exist: his E is written 'Golden Onslaught' and his R 'Final Retribution' in six fields. The R was also referred to only as 'Ultimate' throughout the full layer. His Q's recast knockup, the auto-reset, and the fact that both Q and R heal him were never stated.
audit.why: The applicable-interactions file names them The Darkin Glaive (Q), Aureate Rush (E) and Grim Deliverance (R). The Q resets his attack, heals him, and can be recast for a knockup; the E is a dash that deals max-health damage, so stacking armour reads the trade wrong; the R heals off the damage it deals.
audit.corrected: All six fields moved to the real names; dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the timers, the recast knockup, the reset tell and the heals.
